messages.subject: Error in data extraction in R-SWAT
parts:
Hi!

I'm having some problem getting the correct data in R-SWAT.
After finishing my simulation (in SWAT+) I identified the stream/reach that I would like to calibrate (cha0402), but when I inform column 48 (flo_out) and reach 402 to be extracted by R-SWAT, the data that are presented (graphs) are not correct. The data presented in the QSWAT+ data view for stream 402 are of completely different orders from those shown in the R-SWAT graph (as shown in the attached photos).
How should I proceed to correctly identify the reach/stream I want to calibrate?

Thank you all!

Hello Abu Zafor, look in your channel_sd_***.txt file and look for the reach number you want to calibrate in the column "name", see if the number in the column  "unit" is the same, if they are not the same, use the number in the unit column in rswat and do the test. In my case the numbers were cha0402 (column name) and 335 (column unit), so I managed to extract the data correctly. 
Hope it works.
